UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE, Plaintiff, v. KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6, Defendants. ____________________________________/ | Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

ADMINISTRATIVE DECLARATION OF MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE IN SUPPORT OF PLAINTIFF’S ADMINISTRATIVE MOTION FOR EXPEDITED BRIEFING, PRIORITY DETERMINATION, AND A DEFINED DECISION SCHEDULE FOR THE TWO RULE 26(d)(1) APPLICATIONS

I, Marvelle J. Ballentine, declare as follows:

1.	I am Marvelle J. Ballentine, the Plaintiff in this action. I make this declaration from personal knowledge. Unless a different date is stated, paragraphs 2–12 describe my circumstances as of November 7, 2026.

2.	Before the April 22, 2026 letters, I had never used “Marvelle J. Ballentine” to create, register, identify, maintain, access, or operate any Meta account. I used “Jay Ballentine.” My full legal name appeared in my April 9 materials because it is my legal name and the name in the case captions.

3.	I have never seen a CyberTipline report. I do not know whether a report, as originally received by NCMEC or submitted by Meta, contains my full legal name.

4.	As of November 7, 2026, I had not received the sworn answers requested in the companion applications from any defendant or its counsel.

5.	Approximately two years before November 7, 2026, I was refused legal services. I understood the refusal to be attributable, at least in part, to the child-sexual-exploitation designation associated with my Meta account. That refusal occurred before NCMEC’s April 22, 2026 letters.

6.	I intend to retain counsel to assume responsibility for my pending litigation. I want to devote more of my time and attention to developing Docket Entry and to my family.

7.	My earlier experience makes me reluctant to expose myself to another rejection while the association between my full legal name and CyberTipline reports remains unresolved. The April 22 letters, their presence in the public litigation record, NCMEC’s defense of them as accurate, and Meta’s description of them as “the exact discovery” have added to that concern.

8.	I am actively developing Docket Entry, an AI-assisted litigation technology business. My work includes developing technology, litigation workflows, and the professional and operational foundation of the business.

9.	My concern about the unresolved public association affects my willingness to participate openly in professional networking, business development, technology incubators, accelerator programs, and founder fellowships.

10.	Those activities involve my identity and professional credibility. I am concerned that the public association may arise in inquiries or record searches connected with those activities.

11.	The continuing uncertainty causes me stress and affects my daily work and family responsibilities. It also affects my intended transition from handling the litigation myself to devoting more attention to Docket Entry and my family.

12.	Accurate sworn reporting information would inform my decisions about seeking counsel and participating openly in professional activities. I want to be able to explain what each organization has stated from its own records. The original-name and account-reporting questions remain unanswered.

13.	[NCMEC/Hall conferral. Complete only from the actual November 9, 2026 conference or documented attempts: the date; the time, Eastern; the method (telephone or in person); the participants by name; the items I presented (the seven-day opposition period, the three-day reply period, the seven-day determination request, paper submission, and the retention-or-referral alternatives); counsel’s stated position on each item; any different timetable counsel proposed and the reason counsel gave. If no conference occurred, state each attempt, its date, time, and means, and any response. State agreement only if counsel expressed it.]

14.	[Meta conferral. The corresponding facts, separately attributed to counsel for Meta, in the same form.]

15.	[Service and notice. Complete only with delivery or notice facts that have occurred when this declaration is signed: each document transmitted; each recipient; each date; each method. Identify separately the date of submission through the Court’s Electronic Document Submission System and any courtesy copy sent by email or otherwise, identified as a courtesy copy and not as service. Do not state that the Clerk has docketed the submission or that a Notice of Electronic Filing has been transmitted unless that event has occurred when this declaration is signed.]

[Attach correspondence only if it is relied on in paragraphs 13–15, labeled as an exhibit to this declaration, and identify it here. If none is attached, replace this bracket with: “No correspondence is attached to this declaration.”]

I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct.

Executed on __________, 2026.

Marvelle J. Ballentine
